column2: You are not as impressive as the rumors claimed...

(D-damn it!!)
You there. I will buy your strength.
How much do you want, hm?
Defeat these men, and I will prepare a special payment for you. What do you say?
If you need money, kill him and take it.
That is the law of this $$世界$$, is it not?
If you wish to survive as well, do not waste your breath.
Or would you rather die by my hand than by those white $$羽$$?
Guh...
(Has he gone...?)
Damn it! Get back here, you bastard! This is not over yet!!
You cannot hope to defeat my $$兵士達$$, on whom I have spent a fortune.
Excellent! I will raise your wages by ten percent!
Do not damage that armor too badly. It is going into my collection!!
Not bad. Surrender, and I will hire you myself.
Hey! Do not run away! Even if you run, your debts will always catch up with you!
For every one you defeat, I will pay another ten-thousand bonus!
Pathetic! Do not stand in my way!!
I am sorry...
Please, run away quickly!!
What?!
I do not really want to fight, so stay away from me!!
Guh!! S-so tough!!
What the hell are you?!
So you are the white $$羽$$ I have heard about...
Hmph. What can you possibly do with strength like that?
What was that, you bastard?!
(Damn it! What is this strength?!)
You! Who are you?!
Move! I will take him on! Keep your hands off!!
You muscle-brained idiot! Get a better grasp of the situation!!
White $$羽$$ sure do talk a lot...
(Is the age shifting once again...?)
Th-this power... greater even than a $$神官$$'s...
Someone weaker than I am means to stand against the $$教団$$... against him...?
Fools...
W-why can you negate it so completely?!
...Hm. You wield quite an interesting power...
I suppose I shall see it through.
You are not as impressive as the rumors claimed...
Well then, see that you survive, powerless white $$羽$$.
W-what?! The $$傭兵$$s I gathered at such great expense were beaten so easily...?!
They ran away.
What do you say? Shall we fall back and regroup for now?
Return to the city for now
Pursue $$マモン$$
